notes:
I found two free drop-in options in Halton Hills. Both come from the operators' own pages.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Kids & Me Drop-In Neighbourhood Group, Halton Hills Public Library, Acton Branch",
      "age_fit": "families with babies or children up to 6 years of age",
      "when": "Thursdays 1 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. Follows the school calendar, starting the second week of September. Closed for the December/January holidays, spring/summer breaks and statutory holidays.",
      "price": "Free",
      "source_name": "Halton Region"
    },
    {
      "name": "EarlyON Child and Family Centres, Acton and Georgetown (Halton Hills)",
      "age_fit": "children from birth to their 6th birthday with a parent or caregiver",
      "price": "Free",
      "source_name": "Links2Care"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Kids & Me:** Halton Region's page lists the Acton library group on Thursdays. 
It is a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program.
 
No registration is required. You drop in during program hours.
 The same page lists its other locations in Milton and Oakville, which I left out.
- **EarlyON:** Links2Care's page says 
these are free programs for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers, offered in Halton Hills.
 
They run on weekdays, weekends and evenings, and include drop-in sessions.
 The page's current schedule sits further down the page and didn't come through in my search. Because of that, I've left out specific days and times for this one.

I didn't include the Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre preschool drop-in for under-4s, because it costs $15 and you asked for free.
